variants.headline: Looking back: home world raises its demands
variants.sub: The demands placed on the colony by the home world have increased.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The home world had raised what it demands of the colony.

Our politics begins from the conviction that authority should answer a serious question about legitimacy. Distance does not remove that question. A larger demand deserves examination in terms of what the colony owes and what its people can justly be asked to bear, rather than submission to a grand title.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We regard {target} critically. A higher demand deserves more than automatic deference, and authority should not be excused from defending the fairness of what it asks other people to bear.

variants.headline: Looking back: distant authority asks for more
variants.sub: The home world has raised what it demands of the colony.
variants.body:
The headline belongs to {first_reported}. Our original account recorded this: The home world was demanding more from {colony}.

Our politics begins from the conviction that authority should answer a serious question about legitimacy. Distance does not remove that question. A larger demand deserves examination in terms of what the colony owes and what its people can justly be asked to bear, rather than submission to a grand title.

What has changed since then should be examined against that original record. What has not changed is the need to distinguish an established event from the hopes or fears attached to it.

We regard {target} critically. A higher demand deserves more than automatic deference, and authority should not be excused from defending the fairness of what it asks other people to bear.
